question: In a certain code language, 'NOISY' is coded as '53'.and 'TONE' is coded as '54'. How will 'FORM' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Sum of opposite letter place value = number.

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1193e2a10d634a0705a69e89d090a60cdb93d9237d4aef922ba6b5b5fe83f06.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f32c4dca00f84ef1d704620c1d6c352c16fafec5300b312c3a81cd2900e052d8.png] 

Hence, '**56**' is the correct answer.
